zh: 年初四夜里“接财神”。胡雪岩因为这一年顺利非凡，真象遇见了财神菩萨似地，所以这天夜里“烧财神纸”，他的心情异常虔诚，照规矩，凡是敬神的仪节，妇女都得回避，胡雪岩一个人孤零零地上香磕头，既鲜兄弟，又无儿子，忽然感从中来，觉得身后茫茫，就算财神菩萨垂青，发上几千万两银子的大财，有何用处。等把财神“接”回来，全家在后厅“散福饮胙”，胡老太太倒很高兴，胡雪岩却神情忧郁，勉强吃了两杯酒、半碗鸡汤面，放下筷子就回卧房去了。“怎么了？”胡老太太很不安地低声问儿媳妇：“接财神的日子，而且吃夜饭辰光，还是有说有笑的，忽然变成这副样子，是不是你又跟他说了啥？”“没有！我什么话也没有说。”胡太太说，“新年新岁，一家要图个吉利，我不会跟他淘闲气的。”他婆婆的连连点头，显得十分欣慰，“我晓得你贤惠，雪岩有今天，也全亏你。”她抚慰着说，“不过，他外面事情多，应酬也是免不了的。你的气量要放宽来！”前面的话都好，最后一句说坏了，胡太太对婆婆大起反感，想答一句：“我的气量已经够大了！”但话到口边，到底又咽了下去。
en: On the night of the fourth day of the New Year, the household welcomed the God of Wealth. Hu Xueyan’s extraordinary success during the past year had made him feel as though he had indeed encountered the god, and he burned the ritual paper offerings with unusual devotion. According to custom, women withdrew from ceremonies honouring the gods. As he stood alone offering incense and kowtowing, with neither brothers nor a son beside him, he was suddenly overcome by sadness. What lay beyond him seemed utterly empty. Even if the God of Wealth favoured him with a fortune of tens of millions of taels, what use would it be? When the god had been welcomed, the family gathered in the rear hall to share the blessed offerings. Old Mrs Hu was delighted, but her son looked melancholy. Forcing down two cups of wine and half a bowl of noodles in chicken broth, he put down his chopsticks and returned to his bedroom. “What is wrong?” his mother asked her daughter-in-law anxiously in a low voice. “On the very day we welcome the God of Wealth! He was still laughing and talking at dinner. Why the sudden change? Have you said something to him again?” “No. I haven’t said a word,” Mrs Hu replied. “At the beginning of a new year, we all want good fortune for the household. I wouldn’t pick a quarrel with him.” Her mother-in-law nodded repeatedly, much comforted. “I know how good you are. He owes his success to you too. But he has so much business outside, and entertaining is unavoidable. You must be more broad-minded.” All had been well until that last remark. It provoked a sharp resentment in Mrs Hu. She wanted to say that she was broad-minded enough already, but swallowed the words.

zh: 回到卧房，只见胡雪岩一个人在灯下想心事，胡太太想起婆婆的话，忘掉了那令人不怡的一句，只记着“他外面事多”这句话，心便软了，也亏他一个赤手空拳，打出这片天下，在家里，凡事总要让他。于是她问：“你好象没有吃饭，有红枣莲子粥在那里，要不要吃点甜的？”胡雪岩摇摇头，两眼依旧望着那盏水晶玻璃的“洋灯”。“那么，睡吧！”“你不要管我！”胡雪岩不耐烦他说，“你睡你的。”一片热心换他的冷气，胡太太心里很不舒服，“他在想啥？”她暗中自问自答：“自然是想湖州的那个狐狸精！”这一下，只觉得酸味直冲脑门，忍了又忍，噙着眼泪管自己铺床，而胡雪岩却发了话。“喂！”他说：“我看你要找个妇产医生去看看！”听这一说，朝太太大为诧异，“为啥？”她问，不敢转过脸去，怕丈夫发现她的泪痕。“为啥？”胡雪岩说，“ ‘屁股后头光塌塌’，你倒不着急？”这是指她未生儿子。胡太太又气又恼，倏地转过身来瞪着她丈夫。
en: Back in the bedroom she found Hu sitting alone under the lamp, lost in thought. Remembering his mother’s words, she forgot the offending sentence and thought only of his many affairs outside. Her heart softened. He had built all this from nothing, with his own hands. At home she ought to give way to him. “You hardly ate,” she said. “There is rice porridge with red dates and lotus seeds. Would you like something sweet?” Hu shook his head, his eyes still fixed on the clear glass of the foreign lamp. “Then come to bed.” “Leave me alone,” he answered impatiently. “Go to bed yourself.” His cold response to her kindness hurt her. What was he thinking of? Naturally, that fox-spirit in Huzhou! Jealousy rushed straight to her head. Controlling herself with difficulty, she made the bed with tears in her eyes. Then Hu spoke. “Listen. I think you ought to consult a physician about childbearing.” She was astonished. “Why?” She dared not turn round, lest he see the traces of tears. “Why? There is nothing behind us but emptiness. Doesn’t that worry you?” He meant that she had borne him no son. Angry and distressed, she turned abruptly and stared at him.

zh: “没有儿子是犯‘七出之条’的。”胡太太瞪了一会，爆出这么句话来。这句话很重，胡雪岩也愣了，“怎么说得上这话？”他实在有些困惑，原也知道妻子胸有丘壑，不是等闲的女流，却想不到说出话来比刀口还锋利。“我怎么不要说？”胡太太微微冷笑着：“生儿育女是两个人的事，莫非天底下有那等人，只会生女儿，不会生儿子？你既然要这样说，自然是我退让，你好去另请高明。”为来为去为的是芙蓉，胡雪岩听出因头，不由得笑了，“你也蛮高明的。”他说：“ ‘先开花，后结果’，我的意思是不妨请教请教妇科医生，配一服‘种子调经丸’试试看。”胡太太实在厉害，不肯无理取闹，态度也变得平静了，但话很扎实，掌握机会，谈到要紧关头上：“试得不灵呢？”她问。胡雪岩已具戒心，不敢逞强，“不灵只好不灵，”他带点委屈的声音，“命中注定无子，还说点啥？”有道是“柔能克刚”，他这两句仿佛自怨自艾的话，倒把胡太太的嘴堵住了。这一夜夫妇同床异梦，胡太太通前彻后想了一遍，打定了一个主意。
en: “Bearing no son is one of the seven grounds for putting away a wife.” After staring a moment, she burst out with this. It was a heavy accusation, and Hu too was taken aback. “How can you say such a thing?” He was genuinely bewildered. He knew his wife had a mind of her own and was no ordinary woman, but had not expected words sharper than a knife. “Why shouldn’t I?” she asked with a faint, cold smile. “Having children concerns two people. Is there anyone in the world who can bear only daughters and never sons? Since that is what you say, naturally I must give way, and you can seek someone more capable.” It all came back to Furong. Recognising the cause, Hu could not help smiling. “You are capable enough yourself. First the blossom, then the fruit. I only meant that we might consult a physician who treats women and try a course of Fertility and Menstrual-Regulating Pills.” His wife was formidable indeed. She would not quarrel without reason, and now grew calm, but her words remained firm. Seizing the opportunity, she came to the crucial point. “And if they don’t work?” Hu was on his guard and dared not press his advantage. “Then they don’t work,” he said, sounding a little aggrieved. “If fate has decreed that I shall have no son, what is there to say?” Softness overcomes strength: those two apparently self-pitying remarks left her with no answer. That night they shared a bed but followed different thoughts. Mrs Hu considered the whole matter from beginning to end and made up her mind.

zh: 于是第二天胡老太太问儿子：“你打算哪一天到上海去？”“到上灯就走。”“今天初五，上灯还有八天。”胡老太太说，“也还来得及。”“娘！”胡雪岩诧异的问道：“什么来得及来不及？”胡老太太告诉他，胡太太要回娘家，得要算一算日子，趁胡雪岩未走之前，赶回家来。胡太太娘家在杭州附近的一个水乡塘栖，往返跋涉，也辛苦得很，如果日子局促，一去就要回来，便犯不着吃这一趟辛苦了。“那倒奇怪了，她怎么不先跟我谈？”“我也问她，说你晓得不晓得？她说先要我答应了，再告诉你。”话是说得礼与理都占到了，而其实不是那么一回事，每一次归宁都是夫妇俩先商量好了，方始禀告堂上的，何以这一次例外？同时一接了财神，商场上便得请吃春酒，胡雪岩要趁这几天大请其客，不能没有人照料，此刻怎抽得出工夫回娘家？他把这一层意思一说，胡老太太答道：“ 我也提到了。她说你请客是在店里，用不着她，她也帮不上忙。请几家亲眷吃春酒，日子也定了，就是明天。”“岂有此理！”胡雪岩不悦，“怎么不先告诉我？”
en: The next morning his mother asked, “When do you intend to leave for Shanghai?” “When the lanterns go up.” “Today is the fifth. There are eight days before then. There is still time.” “Mother!” Hu asked in surprise. “Time for what?” She explained that his wife wanted to visit her own family. They must count the days so that she could return before he left. Her family lived in Tangqi, a water town near Hangzhou. The journey there and back was tiring. If time was so short that she had to turn round almost as soon as she arrived, it would hardly be worth the trouble. “How strange! Why didn’t she discuss it with me first?” “I asked whether you knew. She said she must have my consent before telling you.” That explanation satisfied both courtesy and reason, but it was not how things usually happened. On every previous visit, husband and wife had agreed first and then informed their elders. Why was this time different? Besides, once the God of Wealth had been welcomed, merchants began giving their New Year dinners. Hu intended to entertain extensively over the next few days and needed someone to manage matters. How could she leave just now? When he explained this, his mother answered, “I mentioned that too. She said you would entertain at the shop and wouldn’t need her; she could be of no help there. As for the family dinner, the date has already been fixed. It is tomorrow.” “This is absurd!” Hu was annoyed. “Why wasn’t I told first?”

zh: 胡老太太因为已经知道芙蓉的事，觉得儿媳妇受了委屈，不免袒护，所以这时候便“揽是非”，说是她的主意，与胡太太无关。看这样子，胡雪岩认为以少开口为妙，冷笑一声答道：“随便她！反正在家里是她大！”这句话的言外之意，做娘的自然听得出来，“这个家也亏得她撑恃，”她警告儿子：“你不要以为你在外头，就没有人管你，高兴怎么样就怎么样！如果你真的存了这个念头，将来苦头有得你吃！“知子莫若母，一句话说到胡雪岩心里，他也颇生警惕，不过事情多想一想也不能无怨，“娘！”他说，“ ‘不孝有三，无后为大’，难道你老人家就不想抱孙子？”“我怎么不想？”胡老太太平静他说，“这件事我们婆媳已经商量过了。媳妇不是不明事理的人，我做婆婆的，自然要依从她的打算。““她是怎么样打算？”“你先不要问。”胡老太太笑道，“总于你有好处就是了。”胡雪岩猜不透她们婆媳葫芦里卖的是什么药，也就只好暂且丢开。
en: His mother already knew about Furong and felt her daughter-in-law had been wronged, so she was inclined to protect her. Taking the blame, she said the arrangement was her own idea and had nothing to do with Mrs Hu. Seeing how matters stood, Hu thought it best to say little. He gave a cold laugh. “Let her please herself. At home she is the one in command, anyway.” His mother naturally understood the implication. “This household depends on her,” she warned him. “Don’t imagine that because you are outside, nobody can control you and you can do whatever you please. If that is what you think, there is trouble in store for you.” Nobody knows a son like his mother. Her words went straight to his thoughts and made him wary. Yet on reflection he could not entirely suppress his grievance. “Mother, of the three failures in filial duty, leaving no heir is the greatest. Don’t you want a grandson?” “Of course I do,” she answered calmly. “Your wife and I have discussed it. She is a reasonable woman. As her mother-in-law, naturally I should follow her plan.” “What is her plan?” “Don’t ask yet.” His mother smiled. “It will be to your benefit.” Unable to guess what the two women were plotting, Hu could only leave the matter for the time being.

zh: 第二天在家请过了春酒。胡太太便带着八岁的小女儿，雇了一只专船回塘栖，这一去只去了五天，正月十一回杭州。他们夫妇感情本来不坏，虽然略有龃龋，经此小别，似乎各已忘怀，仍旧高高兴兴地有说有笑。胡雪岩打算正月十四动身，所以胡太太一到家，使得替丈夫打点行李，他个人的行李不多，多的是带到松江、上海去送人的土产，“四杭”以外，吃的、用的，样数很不少，一份一份料理，着实累人。土产都是凭折子大批取了来的，送礼以外，当然也留坐自用，胡雪岩打开一包桂花猪油麻酥糖，吃了一块不想再吃，便喊者他的小女儿说：“荷珠，你来吃了它。”拿起酥糖咬了一口，荷珠直摇头：“我不要吃！”“咦！你不是顶喜欢吃酥糖？”“不好吃！”荷珠说，“没有湖州的好吃。”“你在哪里吃的湖州酥糖？”这句话其实问得多余，自然是在外婆家吃的，但“一滴水恰好溶入油瓶里”，略懂人事的荷珠，忽然有所顾忌，竟答不上来，涨红了脸望着他父亲，仿佛做错了什么事伯受责似地。
en: The next day they gave the family New Year dinner. Then Mrs Hu took her younger daughter, aged eight, and hired a boat for the journey to Tangqi. She was away only five days, returning to Hangzhou on the eleventh of the first month. The couple’s relationship had always been fairly good. After this short separation, their slight disagreement seemed forgotten, and they laughed and talked happily as before. Hu intended to leave on the fourteenth, so as soon as his wife returned she had to pack for him. He needed little personal luggage. The bulk consisted of local products to be given away in Songjiang and Shanghai. Besides Hangzhou’s “four specialities,” there were many kinds of food and useful articles. Sorting each gift separately was tiring work. These local goods had been obtained in bulk on account. Naturally, some were kept for the household. Hu opened a packet of crumbly sesame sweets made with lard and scented with osmanthus. After one piece he wanted no more. “Hezhu,” he called to his younger daughter, “come and finish these.” She picked one up, took a bite and shook her head. “I don’t want it.” “Why? Aren’t these your favourite sweets?” “They don’t taste nice. The ones from Huzhou are better.” “Where did you have sweets from Huzhou?” The question was really unnecessary: obviously, at her grandmother’s house. Yet it was like a drop of water falling into an oil bottle. Hezhu was old enough to understand a little of grown-up affairs. Suddenly she grew cautious, could not answer, and looked at her father with a flushed face, as though expecting punishment for some wrongdoing.

zh: 这一来胡雪岩疑云大起，看妻子不在旁边，便拉着荷珠的手，走到窗前，悄悄问道：“你告诉爸爸，哪里来的湖州酥糖？我上海回来，买个洋囡囡给你。”荷珠不知怎么回答？想了半天说：“我不晓得！”做父亲的听这回答，不免生气，但也不愿吓得她哭，只说：“好！你不肯告诉我，随便你！等我上海回来，姐姐有新衣裳，洋囡囡，你呢，什么没有！”威胁利诱之下，荷珠到底说了实话：“娘带回来的。”“娘到湖州去过了？”“嗯。”荷珠委屈他说，“我也要去，娘不许！”“噢！去了几天？”“一天去，一天回来。”“那么是两天。”胡雪岩想了想又问，“你娘回来以后，跟外婆说了些什么？”“我不晓得。我走过去要听。娘叫我走开。娘又说，不准我说，娘到湖州去过。”荷珠说到这里，才感觉事态严重，“爸爸，爸爸，你千万不要跟娘去说，说我告诉你，娘到湖州去过。”“不会，不会！”胡雪岩把她搂在怀里，“我买洋囡囡给你。”
en: Hu’s suspicions rose at once. Seeing that his wife was not nearby, he took Hezhu to the window and asked quietly, “Tell Papa where those Huzhou sweets came from. When I return from Shanghai, I’ll bring you a foreign doll.” She did not know what to say. After thinking for a long while, she answered, “I don’t know.” This annoyed him, though he did not want to frighten her into tears. “Very well. If you won’t tell me, please yourself. When I return from Shanghai, your sister will have new clothes and a foreign doll. You will have nothing.” Between the threat and the reward, Hezhu finally told the truth. “Mother brought them back.” “Mother went to Huzhou?” “Mm.” She sounded aggrieved. “I wanted to go too, but she wouldn’t let me.” “Oh! How many days was she away?” “One day to go, one day to come back.” “Two days, then.” Hu thought a moment. “When she came back, what did she say to Grandmother?” “I don’t know. I went over to listen, and she sent me away. She also said I mustn’t tell anyone she had been to Huzhou.” Only now did Hezhu realise how serious this was. “Papa, Papa, you mustn’t tell Mother that I told you she went to Huzhou.” “I won’t, I won’t.” He gathered her into his arms. “I’ll buy you the foreign doll.”

zh: 安抚了荷珠，胡雪岩大上心事。他妻子的湖州之行，不用说，自然是为了芙蓉，但她干了些什么，却难以揣恻，是去打听了一番，还是另有什么作为？照他的了解，她做事极有分寸，决不是蛮横无理的悍泼之妇可比。意识到这一点，他越觉得自己不可鲁莽，必须谋定后动，或者说，兵来将挡，水来土掩，看她是用的什么办法，再来设计破她。只要知道了她的用意和行动，一定有办法应付，这一点胡雪岩是有信心的。不过他也有警惕，自己所遭遇的“对手”太强，不可造次，同时估量形势，在家里他非常不利，上有老母，下有一双女儿，都站在他妻子这面，自己以一敌四，孤掌难鸣。所以眼前的当务之急，是要争取优势，而这个工作只能在暗地里做，让妻子知道了，只要稍加安抚，“地盘”就会非常稳固。于是他首先还是找到荷珠，告诫她不可将他所问的话，告诉她母亲。然后又找他的大女儿，十五岁的梅王。梅玉很懂人事了，虽是她母亲的“死党”，却很崇拜父亲，因而胡雪岩跟她说话，另有一套计算，一开口就说：“梅王，你跟爸爸一起到上海去，好不好？”这话让梅玉又惊又喜。能出去开一开眼界，又听说十里夷场有数不尽的新奇花样，自然向往万分，但离开母亲，又仿佛觉调不能令人安心，所以只骨碌碌地转着一对黑眼珠，半晌答不出话来。
en: Having reassured Hezhu, Hu was deeply troubled. Naturally his wife’s journey to Huzhou concerned Furong, but what she had done was hard to guess. Had she merely made inquiries, or taken some other action? He knew she had an excellent sense of measure and was nothing like a violent, unreasonable shrew. That made it all the more necessary for him to avoid rashness. He must plan before acting—or, as the saying went, meet soldiers with generals and floodwater with earth: discover her move and devise the proper answer. Once he knew her purpose and actions, he was confident he could deal with them. But this was a powerful opponent, and he must be careful. At home the odds were against him. His mother above and his two daughters below all stood on his wife’s side. One against four, he could hardly prevail. His immediate task was therefore to gain an advantage, and he could do it only in secret. If his wife learned of it, a little reassurance from her would make her position unshakable. First he sought Hezhu out again and warned her not to tell her mother what he had asked. Then he approached his elder daughter, fifteen-year-old Meiyu. She understood a good deal of the world. Though firmly her mother’s ally, she admired her father, so he adopted a different approach. “Meiyu, would you like to come to Shanghai with Papa?” The proposal surprised and delighted her. She longed to see something of the world, especially the foreign settlement with its countless novelties. Yet leaving her mother seemed unsettling. Her dark eyes moved to and fro, and for a while she could not answer.

zh: “你的意思怎么样？不愿意？”“哪个说不愿意？”梅玉说，“我有点怕。”“怕？那完了！”胡雪岩说，“爸爸还想靠你，你先怕了！”“靠我！”梅玉大惑不解，怎么样也不能接受这话，“爸爸，你靠我什么？”“靠你替我写写、算算。”胡雪岩郑重其事他说，“我在外面的生意做得很大，总要有个帮手，这个帮手一定要自己人，因为有些帐目，是不能让别人知道的。哪怕刘庆生刘叔叔、陈世尤陈叔叔，都不能让他们知道。想来想去，只有靠你帮忙。”这一套鬼话，改变了梅王的心情，原来一直当目己是个文弱的女孩子，在外面百无一用，只有帮着操持家务，现在才知道自己还肯派得上紧要用场的地方，顿觉自己变了一个“大人”，而且也不再想到母亲，自觉胆子甚大，出去闯一闯也无所谓。但是，这只是一鼓作气，多想一想不免气馁，“爸爸，”她说，“我怕我算不来帐。”“那么，你帮你娘记家用帐，是怎么记的呢？”“家用帐是家用帐。爸爸的帐是上千上万的进出。”“帐目不管大小，算法是一样的，家用帐琐琐碎碎，我的帐只有几样东西，还比家用帐好记。”梅平接受了鼓励，“雄心”又起，毅然决然的说：“那我就跟了爸爸去，不过我要把阿彩带了去。”阿彩是专门照料她的一个丫头，胡雪岩当然答应。事情就这样说定局了。
en: “What do you think? Don’t you want to go?” “Who says I don’t?” Meiyu replied. “I’m a little afraid.” “Afraid? Then that settles it! I was hoping to rely on you, and you are afraid already.” “Rely on me?” She was utterly bewildered. “Papa, what could you rely on me for?” “To write things down and do calculations for me.” Hu sounded thoroughly serious. “My business outside has grown very large. I need someone to help, and it must be one of our own family. There are accounts nobody else can know about—not even Uncle Liu Qingsheng or Uncle Chen Shilong. I have thought it over, and you are the only person I can rely on.” This fabrication changed her feelings completely. Until now she had regarded herself as a frail girl, useless outside the home and fit only to help with household affairs. Suddenly she discovered that she could perform an important service. She felt grown-up at once. She stopped thinking of her mother, became bold, and saw no harm in venturing out into the world. But the first burst of courage faded under further reflection. “Papa, I’m afraid I won’t know how to keep the accounts.” “How do you keep the household accounts for your mother, then?” “Those are household accounts. Your money comes and goes in thousands and tens of thousands.” “Large or small, the method is the same. Household accounts are full of little items. Mine concern only a few things. They are easier to keep.” Encouraged, Meiyu’s ambition rose again. “Then I’ll go with you,” she declared. “But I must take A’cai.” A’cai was the maid who looked after her. Naturally Hu agreed, and the matter was settled.

zh: 这一来，全家大小都知道了这回事，而胡太太只当丈夫说笑话。“你要把梅玉带到上海去啊？”她问她丈夫。“对！”胡雪岩说，“女儿大了，带她出去阅历阅历。”“阅历！”胡太太诧异之至，“听说夷场上的风气不好，有啥好阅历？学了些坏样子回来，你害了她！“胡雪岩笑笑不作声。这有何可笑？女孩子学坏学好，有关终身，不是好笑的事，那自然是笑自己的话没见识！胡太太倒有些不服气了。“我的话说锗了？”她平静而固执地，“而且听说路上不平靖，梅玉不要去！”“路上不平靖，那么我呢？你倒放心得下？”“你跟梅玉不同。”胡太太说，“又有尤五爷照应，我自然放心。”“那就对了，梅王跟我在一起，你还有啥不放心？”夫妇俩的交谈，针锋相对，而且是“绵里针”，劲道暗藏着，但毕竟还是胡雪岩占了上风，胡太太争不过他，还有一着棋，拿老太太搬了出来。
en: Soon everyone in the household knew, though Mrs Hu supposed her husband was joking. “Are you taking Meiyu to Shanghai?” she asked. “Yes. She is growing up. I want her to gain some experience.” “Experience!” His wife was astonished. “They say the foreign settlement has bad ways. What experience is there to gain? If she comes home with bad habits, you will have ruined her.” Hu only smiled. What was amusing? A girl’s conduct affected her whole future. It was no laughing matter. He must be laughing at her ignorance! Mrs Hu resented it. “Am I wrong?” she asked, calmly but stubbornly. “Besides, they say the roads are unsafe. Meiyu is not to go.” “If the roads are unsafe, what about me? Aren’t you worried?” “You and Meiyu are different. With Master You looking after you, naturally I feel easy.” “Exactly. If she is with me, what is there to worry about?” Their words met point against point, needles hidden in silk, with all their force concealed. Yet Hu had gained the upper hand. Unable to defeat him in argument, his wife made one last move: she brought his mother into it.

zh: 对母亲说话，自然不能那样子一句钉一句，胡雪岩依旧是对梅玉的那套说法，说要有个亲信的人替他管帐，不过一套假话，比对梅玉说的还要详细，他说有些交际应酬的帐目，没有凭证，如果不是当时记下来，事后就搞不清楚。而这些帐目，无论如何是不能让外人知道的，所以要把梅王带去帮忙。说到这里，他叹口气：“如果有男孩子，何必要带梅玉出去？哪怕有个亲侄儿也好了！苦的就是没有。“这是胡雪岩灵机一动的攻心之计。胡老太太果然在想，梅玉如果是个男孩，十五岁便可以跟他父亲出去“学生意”，有五六年下来，足可以成为你父亲的一个得力帮手，生意做得发达了，不患后继无人。如今就算马上有了孩子，要到十几年以后，才能成人，缓不济急，对胡家来说，是吃了亏了，不免有些怨儿媳妇，耽误了这十几年的大好时光。这一下胡太太又落了下风，胡雪岩则甚为得意，但再想进一步打听他妻子到了湖州的情形，却是失望，听梅玉的口气，她母亲根本没有跟她说过。
en: With his mother he could not answer every objection so sharply. He returned to the story he had told Meiyu: he needed someone he could trust to keep accounts. This time the fabrication was more detailed. Some expenses for entertaining and social dealings had no receipts. Unless they were recorded at once, they became impossible to disentangle later. Nobody outside the family could be allowed to know these accounts, so he needed Meiyu’s help. Then he sighed. “If I had a boy, why should I have to take Meiyu? Even a nephew of my own would do. The trouble is that I have neither.” This was an inspired appeal to his mother’s feelings. She immediately began to think that, had Meiyu been a boy, at fifteen he could have gone out with his father to learn business. In five or six years he would be a capable assistant, and the growing enterprise would have someone to inherit it. Even if a boy were born now, more than ten years must pass before he grew up. That could not meet their present need. The Hu family had lost an opportunity. She could not help blaming her daughter-in-law for wasting all these good years. Once again Mrs Hu was at a disadvantage, and her husband was pleased with himself. But when he tried to discover more about her visit to Huzhou, he was disappointed. From what Meiyu said, her mother had told her nothing of it.

zh: 就在这天晚上，钱庄里派人来通知，说刘不才已经从湖州回来，请胡雪岩去有话说，可想而知的，必是关于芙蓉的事，否则刘不才也是熟客，何不到家来谈？估量到这一层，他首先就要注意他妻子的态度：“奇怪！”他试探着说：“刘不才怎么不来？反要我去看他。”“你管他呢！”胡太太夷然不以为意，“你去了再说。”胡太太的沉着实在厉害了！等跟刘不才见了面，才知道她跟芙蓉已经见过面，只说她是跟胡雪岩共患难的糟糠之妻，然后留下一张五千两银票，就告辞了。“有这样的事！”胡雪岩说，“我实在想不到。”“谁也没有想到。”刘不才很尴尬的说：“芙蓉要我来问你的意思，才好作去留之计。”于是胡雪岩又改回原来的称呼：“三叔！”他说，“请你仍旧回湖州，叫芙蓉不必着急。我自有办法。”“是什么办法呢？”“这一时说不清楚。”胡雪岩这样答道：“三叔，反正我一定对得起芙蓉就是了。”这话恰好是刘不才听不进去的，照他的私心打算，最好胡雪岩再给个三两万银子，让芙蓉下堂，别求归宿，省得自己沾上这点不十分光彩的裙带亲。而现在听他的口气，适得其反，刘不才虽然失望，却不便多说什么。
en: That evening a messenger came from the bank. Liu Bucai had returned from Huzhou and wanted Hu to come and speak with him. Obviously it concerned Furong. Otherwise, Liu was familiar enough with the household to call there himself. Having worked this out, Hu first watched his wife’s reaction. “How strange,” he said, sounding her out. “Why doesn’t Liu come here? Why must I go to him?” “Never mind that,” she answered with complete unconcern. “Go and find out.” Her composure was formidable indeed. Only when Hu met Liu did he learn that she had already seen Furong. She had simply introduced herself as the wife who had shared Hu’s hardships, left a five-thousand-tael banknote and taken her leave. “Such a thing!” Hu exclaimed. “I never imagined it.” “Nobody did.” Liu was embarrassed. “Furong sent me to ask your wishes before she decides whether to stay or go.” Hu returned to his former mode of address. “Third Uncle, please go back to Huzhou and tell Furong not to worry. I shall find a way.” “What way?” “I cannot explain just now. Whatever happens, I shall deal honourably with her.” This was precisely what Liu did not want to hear. Privately, he hoped Hu would give another twenty or thirty thousand taels, release Furong to find another home, and spare him this not altogether creditable connection through his niece. Hu’s words suggested the opposite. Disappointed, Liu could say little.

zh: “你新年里的手气如何？”胡雪岩故作闲豫地问。这一问，刘不才又高兴了，“实在不错！”他笑得合不拢口，“所向披靡，斩获甚丰。”大概是赢得不少。胡雪岩心想，趁这时候得要规劝几句。“三叔！”他说，“ ‘瓦罐不离井上破，将军难免阵前亡’你见过哪个是在赌上发迹的，现在你手上很有几文了，应该做点正事。”“我的帐都还清了。”刘不才说，“还赢进一张田契，我已经托郁四去替我过户营业。”说到这里，他又感慨他说，“一个人真是穷不得！手头有几个钱，别人马上不同，就在这几天，有好几个人来替我做媒，劝我续弦。”“那是好事啊！”“不忙！”刘不才摇摇头，“让我潇潇洒洒，先过几年清闲日子再说。”“这就不对了！未曾发财，先想纳福，吃苦在后头。”胡雪岩说：“三叔，我劝你把世德堂恢复起来。”“咦！”刘不才诧异，“你不是要我帮你开庆余堂吗？”这件事几乎连胡雪岩自己都已忘记了，“自己人我说实话，这要慢慢再说了。就是开起来，我也要另外请人，三叔，”他说，“你的长处不在这上面。“
en: “How has your luck been over the New Year?” Hu asked, feigning leisure. This cheered Liu at once. “Excellent!” he said, grinning. “Victorious everywhere, with rich spoils.” He must have won a good deal. Hu thought this a suitable moment for advice. “Third Uncle, the pitcher is bound to break at the well, and the general is bound to die on the battlefield. Have you ever known anyone make his way in the world through gambling? You have a little money now. You ought to turn to serious work.” “All my debts are paid,” Liu replied. “I even won a deed to some land. I have asked Yu Si to arrange the transfer and put me in possession.” Then he grew reflective. “A man really cannot afford to be poor. Once he has a little money, people change towards him at once. In these last few days several people have offered to arrange a marriage for me, urging me to take another wife.” “That would be a good thing.” “There is no hurry.” Liu shook his head. “Let me enjoy a few carefree years first.” “That is wrong. Think of comfort before you have made your fortune, and hardship will come later. Third Uncle, I advise you to restore Shide Hall.” “What?” Liu was surprised. “Weren’t you going to have me help open Hu Qingyu Hall?” Hu had almost forgotten the undertaking himself. “Between ourselves, I shall tell you frankly. That must wait. Even if I open it, I shall have to find someone else. Third Uncle, your strengths lie elsewhere.”

zh: 一听是这样的答话，刘不才不免有些伤心，“雪岩，”他怨艾他说：“你看看我只会赌钱？”“不是这话，不是这话！”胡雪岩倒觉歉然，极力安慰他说，“你的长处我都知道，将来我有大大仰仗你的地方。”“那么眼前呢？”“眼前要看你自己的意思，你的志向是把祖传的基业恢复起来，所以我那样劝你，而且可以帮你的忙。”“我的想法变过了，世德堂就算恢复了，也没有啥意思，叫我守在店里，更加办不到。我想想，还是跟你一起去闯一闯的好。”“那好！”胡雪岩说，“你先回湖州，叫芙蓉放心，关起门来过日子，什么事也不必管，等我上海回来，自有安排。这话说到了，请你跟世龙一起赶到上海来。”
en: This hurt Liu. “Xueyan,” he said reproachfully, “do you think gambling is all I can do?” “Not at all!” Hu felt apologetic and did his best to reassure him. “I know your abilities. There will be important matters in which I must depend on you.” “What about now?” “For now, it depends on your wishes. Your ambition was to restore the family business. That is why I advised it, and I can help you.” “My mind has changed. Even restoring Shide Hall would mean little. I certainly couldn’t stay behind a shop counter. I think I would rather go out into the world with you.” “Very well. First return to Huzhou and put Furong’s mind at rest. Tell her to live quietly at home and concern herself with nothing else. When I return from Shanghai, I shall make arrangements. Once you have delivered that message, come to Shanghai with Shilong.”

zh: 这样说定了，各自分手。胡雪岩已出钱庄，灵机一动，开了张五千两的银票，带在身上，一到家，正好在书房里遇着他妻子，便把那张银票递了过去。胡太太装作不解地问道：“这是啥？”“你白送了五千银子！我贴还你的私房。”胡雪岩又说，“有私房钱，放到钱庄里去生息倒不好？压在箱子底下，大钱不会生小钱的。”看他是这种态度，胡太太倒有些莫测高深了。夫妇俩暗中较劲，到了这样的地步，至矣尽矣，胡太太自然有些不安，心想既然西洋镜已经折穿，就不如敞开来谈了。于是她先表示歉意，“雪岩，你不要怪我事先没有跟你商量！我也是万般无奈，为了一家大小，我们苦了这么多年，你刚刚转运，千万沾染不得‘桃花’，我这样做，是为你好。十几年夫妻，你总晓得我的心。”她停了一下又说，“当然，我另外有打算的，跟娘也讲过，将来你就可以晓得了，我不是不讲道理，乱吃醋的人。”
en: They parted with this agreed. Hu had already left the bank when an idea struck him. He had a five-thousand-tael note drawn and took it home. Finding his wife in the study, he handed it to her. “What is this?” she asked, pretending not to understand. “You gave away five thousand taels for nothing. I am replacing your private savings. Wouldn’t it be better to put your money in the bank and earn interest? Kept at the bottom of a chest, big money won’t breed little money.” His manner left her unable to fathom him. Their silent contest had reached its utmost limit. Uneasy, she thought that, since the secret was out, they had better speak openly. She began with an apology. “Xueyan, don’t blame me for not discussing it with you first. I had no choice. I did it for the whole family. We suffered for so many years, and now that your fortune has only just turned, you must not become entangled in love affairs. It was for your own good. After more than ten years of marriage, you know my heart.” She paused. “Of course, I have another plan, which I have discussed with Mother. You will understand in time. I am not an unreasonable woman consumed by jealousy.”

zh: 最后这几句话，让胡雪岩看穿了她妻子的用心。只要是小康之家，三十一过，尚乏子息，堂上老亲。便会动替儿子置妾的念头，再过五六年，依然有“后顾之忧”，则乡党宗亲都会出来“说公话”，再悍泼的大妇，也得屈服于“不孝有三，无后为大”的“道理”之下，忍气吞声让丈夫另辟偏房。因此，会吃醋的人便作未雨绸缪之计，表面绝不露温色，而且为丈夫置妾之念，表现得非常热切，三天两头找媒婆上门，里外串通，托词宜男之相，找来个粗脚大手，其蠢如牛的女孩子，作为丈夫金屋中的阿娇。同时一进门便立下许多规矩，阃令大如军令，偏房有如敌国，戒备森严，把丈夫摆布得动弹不得。胡雪岩认为他妻子就是这类厉害的角色，所以立刻表示“敬谢不敏”！“你不必瞎打算，我也不会领你的情。”他接着提到芙蓉：“你这趟到湖州去，做错了，大错特错！我跟你说过，是逢场作戏，认不得真，以后我自有摆脱的办法。现在你这一来，倒叫我为难了，如果照你的想头，给个几千银子，让人家走路，说出去是我胡雪岩怕老婆！不要说我面子上下不来，而且人家要想，胡雪岩凡事自己做不得主，你倒说人家还信任不信任我？”
en: Those last words revealed her purpose to Hu. In any reasonably prosperous family, once a son passed thirty without a male heir, his parents began thinking of finding him a concubine. If another five or six years passed and the future remained uncertain, neighbours and clansmen would speak out in the name of fairness. Even the fiercest principal wife had to submit to the argument that leaving no heir was the greatest failure of filial duty, swallow her anger and let her husband take a second woman. Cleverly jealous wives therefore prepared in advance. They showed no anger and seemed positively eager to obtain a concubine, calling matchmakers in every few days. In collusion with them, on the pretext of selecting a woman whose appearance promised sons, they found a girl with broad feet and large hands, as stupid as an ox, to serve as the A’jiao of their husband’s golden house. As soon as she entered, they laid down countless rules. Commands within the women’s quarters were as strict as military orders; the concubine was treated like an enemy state, under such close guard that the husband could scarcely move. Hu considered his wife just such a formidable strategist and immediately declined the favour. “Don’t waste your plans. I shan’t thank you for them.” Then he turned to Furong. “Your journey to Huzhou was a mistake—a very great mistake. I told you it was a passing amusement, nothing to take seriously. I had my own way of extricating myself later. Now you have put me in a difficulty. If I follow your idea, give her a few thousand taels and send her away, everyone will say Hu Xueyan is afraid of his wife. Besides losing face, I shall make people think I cannot decide anything for myself. Tell me, will they still trust me?”

zh: 这番道理把胡太太说得愣住了！她虽精明，到底世面见得少，商场中的习惯和顾忌，哪里懂得透？只好这样辩解：“我一个人去，一个人来，一共只见了一面，谈不到一盏茶的工夫，真正是人不知鬼不觉，哪个会晓得？”“是不是‘鬼不觉’，我不晓得，若要‘人不知’，除非己莫为。不说别的，就说我，先就晓得了。”胡雪岩故意跌足嗟叹：“现在湖州已经在笑话我了！你晓得庞二怎么说？他说，做大生意就象皇帝治天下一样，该杀的杀，该放的放，全靠当机立断，所以切忌女人轧脚。胡雪岩原来要听太太的话！如果说有笔生意来了，发大财或者本钱蚀光，都在当时一句话上，而胡某人说要回去跟太太商量一下看。你们说，这样子怎么合得拢淘来做大生意？”这番编出来的话，把胡太太说得青一阵，红一阵，心里又急又悔，好半晌说不出话来。“你也不要急！”胡雪岩倒过来安慰她，“事情已经做错了，懊悔也无用，眼前只有让他们去笑我，等我上海回来再说。”越是如此，越不能让胡太太安心。夫妇之间为了妾侍，没有不吵得天翻地覆的，即令丈夫脾气好，也不能这样丝毫不带愠色。其中一定有什么花样！同时芙蓉到底怎么样了呢，是知难而退，还是恋恋不舍，也得从丈夫口中讨出一个确实信息来，才好处置。总而言之，事情到此地步，由暗而明，使得干干净净有个了结，如果听任丈夫从上海回来再办，且不说夜长梦多，光是这许多日子他心中怀着不满，就足以使夫妇的感情起变化。
en: This argument left Mrs Hu stunned. Clever as she was, she had seen little of the world. How could she fully understand the habits and anxieties of business? She could only protest, “I went alone and came back alone. We met once, for less time than it takes to drink a cup of tea. Nobody could have known. Who would find out?” “Whether the spirits knew, I cannot say. But if you don’t want people to know of something, don’t do it. Never mind anyone else—I know already.” Hu deliberately stamped and sighed. “They are laughing at me in Huzhou now! Do you know what Pang said? ‘Running a great business is like an emperor ruling the realm. Execute whom you must, spare whom you should—everything depends on deciding at once. Above all, you must not let women hamper your steps. Yet it turns out Hu Xueyan must obey his wife! Suppose an opportunity arises and one immediate word decides between a fortune and the loss of all the capital. Then Hu says he must go home and consult his wife. Tell me, how can anyone join such a man in serious business?’” This invented speech made her turn pale and red by turns. Anxious and remorseful, she could not speak for a long time. Now Hu comforted her. “Don’t distress yourself. What is done is done. Regret will not help. For the moment, let them laugh. We will see when I return from Shanghai.” The more he spoke like this, the less reassured she felt. Disputes between husband and wife over a concubine invariably produced a storm. Even a good-tempered husband could not show absolutely no resentment. There must be some design behind it. And what had become of Furong? Had she withdrawn in the face of difficulty, or was she unwilling to let go? Mrs Hu needed a definite answer before deciding what to do. Now that the matter was out in the open, it ought to be settled cleanly. Waiting until his return from Shanghai invited further complications. Worse still, the resentment he might nurse throughout those days could change their relationship.

zh: 想到这里，胡太太认为丈夫的生意虽然要紧，但这件事更显得紧迫，说不得只好留了下来。“你晚几天走好不好？”她问。真是俗语说的“开口见喉咙”，一听这话，胡雪岩便看透底蕴，却明知故问他说：“为啥？”“梅玉第一趟出远门，总要替她多做点衣服。”胡太太这样托词，“晚个两三天走，也不碍吧？”“你说不碍就不碍。”胡雪岩隐约提出警告：“不过这几天当中，你不要替我惹什么麻烦，弄得我走不成，那就要了我半条命锣。”“有啥麻烦？”胡太太想到自己处处落下风，不免怨恨，便发牢骚似他说，“啥麻烦也难不倒你！反正各凭天良就是了。”说着，眼圈便有些红了。性格刚毅的女子，有此软弱的表示，最易感人，胡雪岩倒觉得心里酸酸地，一伸手扶着她的肩头说：“十几年夫妻，你难道还不晓得我？你有良心，我也有良心，不然我们不会有今天这样的日子。”想到眼前的日子，胡太太又生警惕，也越觉得留住丈夫是个一点不错的做法，她的做法是预备请嵇鹤龄出面来谈判，能让步一定让步。胡雪岩只知道她一定会有动作，却不知道她是打的这个主意。冷静地想一想，发觉到这重纠纷，主客已经易势，原来是自己怀着个鬼胎，深怕妻子进一步追究，此刻变成她急自己不急，以逸待劳，看她使出什么招数，再来设法破它，也还不迟。
en: His business was important, Mrs Hu decided, but this was more urgent. She must ask him to remain. “Could you leave a few days later?” The moment she opened her mouth, as the saying went, he could see straight down her throat. He understood completely, but asked as though he did not, “Why?” “It is Meiyu’s first long journey. We must make her some more clothes,” she said by way of a pretext. “Two or three days’ delay would not matter, would it?” “If you say it won’t matter, it won’t.” He added an indirect warning. “But don’t cause me any trouble in those few days and make it impossible for me to leave. That would take half my life.” “What trouble?” Resenting her constant defeats, she complained, “No trouble can defeat you. Let each of us act according to conscience, that is all.” Her eyes reddened. Such weakness in a strong-minded woman is particularly moving. Hu felt a pang and put a hand on her shoulder. “After more than ten years together, don’t you know me? You have a conscience, and so do I. Otherwise we would not have reached the life we have today.” Thinking of that life made her more watchful and more certain she was right to keep him at home. She intended to ask Ji Heling to mediate and would concede whatever she could. Hu knew she meant to act, but not that this was her plan. Calm reflection showed him that their positions had reversed. At first he had carried a guilty secret and dreaded further questions. Now she was anxious and he was not. He could wait at ease, see what move she made and devise an answer in good time.

zh: 有此闲豫的心情，而且有了多出来的两三天工夫，他忽发雅兴，特地约嵇鹤龄和裘丰言，白天逛湖，晚上吃“皇饭儿”，吃完上城隍山去看灯。裘丰言一诺无辞，嵇鹤龄则辞了逛湖之约，来赴饭局。酒到半酣，话题落到芙蓉身上，一个是异姓手足，一个是无话不谈的好朋友，有了几分酒意的胡雪岩想起对付他妻子的手腕，自觉得意，忍不住大谈特谈。就是这天上午，嵇鹤龄已受了胡太太之托，要来调停此事，便落得听他“自供。裘丰言却不知就里，附和着胡雪岩说：”胡大嫂果然精明，只怕是读过‘妒律’的。“胡雪岩没有听懂，追问一句：“你说啥？”“ ‘妒律’，妒忌之妒，律例之律！”“吃了酒又来信口开河，杜撰故事了。”嵇鹤龄笑道：“从未听说过有此一部律例。”“自然是游戏笔墨，但也不无道理。把大妇的妒心，刻画得无微不至。”裘丰言笑道：“天下凡想纳宠的男子，都当一读。”“那么，”胡雪岩很感兴趣的说，“你倒讲讲这部妒律，是怎么回事？”“分吏、户、礼、兵、刑、工，另加‘各例’、‘督捕律’等，一共八章。有引有判，是绝妙好词。”
en: In this leisurely mood, with two or three extra days at his disposal, Hu suddenly felt like an outing. He invited Ji Heling and Qiu Fengyan to tour the lake by day, dine at Huangfan’er and then climb City God Hill to see the lanterns. Qiu accepted without hesitation. Ji declined the lake excursion but came to dinner. When the wine had warmed them, the conversation turned to Furong. One man was his sworn brother, the other a close friend with whom he could discuss anything. A little tipsy, Hu recalled his handling of his wife, felt pleased with himself and could not resist talking at length. That very morning Ji had been asked by Mrs Hu to mediate, so he was content to hear Hu make his own confession. Qiu knew nothing of this. Agreeing with Hu, he said, “Sister-in-Law Hu is indeed clever. She must have read the Code of Jealousy.” Hu had not understood. “What did you say?” “The Code of Jealousy—jealousy, as in envy; code, as in statutes.” “Wine has set you inventing stories again,” Ji said with a smile. “I have never heard of such a code.” “Naturally it is a literary jest, but not without reason. It depicts a principal wife’s jealous heart in the finest detail. Every man thinking of taking a concubine ought to read it.” Hu was interested. “Then tell us about this code.” “It has eight chapters: Personnel, Revenue, Rites, War, Punishments and Works, with Additional Regulations and the Statutes for Apprehending Offenders. There are citations and judgments. Admirable writing!”

zh: “我念几条来听听！”裘丰言点点头，喝了口酒，来了一个“响铃儿”在嘴里咀嚼得“嘎吱、嘎吱”的响，念念有词的默诵了一会，忽然笑道：“想起来了，你念两条你听，是兵部的军律：”凡妇见夫人妾房言语，即假借公事，突入冲散，拟坐以擅闯辕门律。如止挥扰，不作嗔状，引例未减，笞五十，免供。判曰：翡翠床前，方调鹦鹉之舌，水晶帘外，忽来狮吼之声。不徒花上晒衣，未免腹中藏剑！有心心术不端，无心见识不到。‘“这几句四六是胡雪岩听得懂的，“判得好！‘花上晒衣’，大煞风景，”他说：“真个该打手心！”
en: “Recite a few provisions for us.” Qiu nodded, drank some wine and took a crisp “ringing-bell” roll, crunching it as he silently rehearsed the words. Then he suddenly laughed. “I remember! Here are two for you, from the military statutes: ‘Any wife who sees her husband enter a concubine’s room to converse and, on the pretext of household business, bursts in and breaks up their meeting shall be charged under the statute against unauthorised entry into a military headquarters. If she merely disturbs them without showing anger, the provision for mitigation shall apply: fifty strokes of the light bamboo, with no confession required. The judgment states: Before the jade-green bed, the parrot’s tongue is just being coaxed to speech; beyond the crystal curtain, suddenly comes the roaring of a lion. This is more than hanging washing over flowers: it suggests a sword concealed in the belly. If deliberate, the intentions are improper; if unintentional, the understanding is deficient.’” Hu understood these balanced phrases. “A fine judgment! Hanging washing over flowers—what a way to spoil the scene. She really deserves a beating on the palms.”

zh: “再有一种罪名，就不轻了！”裘丰言又拉长了声调念：“凡妇度与夫正值绸缨之际，忽唤妾起，嘱以他事，拟坐以‘擅调官军’律……”一句话未完；胡雪岩大笑：“好个‘擅调官军’，应得何罪？”“杖一百，发边远充军。”“这未免太重。”嵇鹤龄也笑了。“你说太重，人家以为‘宥以生命，犹为宽曲’。”襄丰言接着念判词：“酣战方深，浪子春风一度，金牌忽召，夫人号令三申，既撤白登之围，讵有黄龙之望？”“想想也是。”胡雪岩问道：“象内人那样，不晓得犯什么‘律’？”裘丰言想了想说：“有这么一条，‘凡妇蓄妾，原非得已，乃自夸贤德，冀人赞美。拟坐现任官辄自立碑律，杖一百。徒三年’。此由‘事因情近，名与实违’，‘盗名有禁，功令宜遵’！”
en: “There is another offence whose penalty is far from light.” Drawing out his voice, Qiu continued: “‘Any wife who judges that her husband and concubine are at a tender moment together, and suddenly calls the concubine away on another errand, shall be charged with unauthorised deployment of government troops...’” Before he finished, Hu burst out laughing. “Excellent! Unauthorised deployment of troops! What is the punishment?” “A hundred strokes of the heavy bamboo and military service on a distant frontier.” “Rather severe,” Ji said, laughing too. “You call it severe, but the author says, ‘To spare her life is already excessive leniency.’” Qiu went on with the judgment: “‘The battle is at its height, the rake enjoying a moment of spring; suddenly a golden tally recalls the troops, and the lady repeats her command three times. Once the siege of Baideng has been lifted, what hope remains of reaching Huanglong?’” “There is something in that,” Hu said. “What statute would a woman like my wife offend against?” Qiu considered. “There is this one: ‘Any wife who agrees to a concubine only because she has no choice, yet boasts of her virtue in hope of praise, shall be charged under the statute against an incumbent official erecting a monument to himself: one hundred strokes of the heavy bamboo and three years’ penal servitude.’ The circumstances are comparable, while the reputation contradicts the reality. ‘Usurping a reputation is prohibited; the regulations must be obeyed.’”

zh: “你不要瞎说！”嵇鹤龄觉得裘丰言的玩笑之谈，有碍他的调停之职，所以阻止他再说下去，“我那位弟妇，决不是那种人，要替雪岩置妾，既非‘名与实违’，更不是‘盗各’。你说的妒律，全不适用。”裘丰言听出他的言外之意，极其见机，“原是不经之谈，”他说，“胡大嫂的贤德，不必自夸，亲友无不深知。”“家家有本难念经……”“雪岩！”嵇鹤龄抢着问道：“你那位新宠，如今怎么样了？”胡雪岩当然没有骗他的道理，老实答道：“好好在湖州。”“还顶着你的姓？”“当然。”胡雪岩忽然发觉嵇鹤龄的态度，与自己不尽符合，便问了一句：“大哥，你说我该怎么办？”“千言并一句，不可因此在家庭中生出意见，否则就是大不幸。”“对，对！”裘丰言又在旁边帮腔，“家和万事兴！雪岩兄鸿运当头，方兴未艾，此时最要得内助的力。”
en: “Stop talking nonsense!” Ji felt that Qiu’s jokes were obstructing his work as mediator and prevented him from continuing. “My sister-in-law is nothing of the kind. Her wish to find Xueyan a concubine neither contradicts her real intentions nor usurps a reputation. Your Code of Jealousy does not apply.” Qiu caught the implication and adapted at once. “It is all fanciful nonsense, of course. Sister-in-Law Hu need not boast of her goodness. All her friends and relations know it.” “Every household has a difficult scripture to recite...” “Xueyan!” Ji interrupted. “What has become of your new favourite?” Hu had no reason to deceive him. “She is living quietly in Huzhou.” “Still under your name?” “Naturally.” Suddenly realising that Ji’s attitude did not entirely agree with his own, Hu asked, “Elder Brother, what do you think I should do?” “A thousand words come to one point: do not let this sow discord in your family. That would be a great misfortune.” “Exactly!” Qiu chimed in. “When the family is harmonious, everything prospers. Brother Xueyan, your good fortune is still rising. Now above all you need your wife’s help.”

zh: 胡雪岩把他们两人一看，笑着说道：“双拳难敌四手，看样子我今天说不过你们了。”“老裘不是外人。我说老实话，我受托调停，即此可以看出弟妇的贤德。”嵇鹤龄又说：“今天上午，我也拜见了伯母，面奉慈谕，要我以长兄的资格，料理这件‘风流官司’。”“高堂之命、贤妻之托、长兄之尊，”裘丰言拍掌笑道：“雪岩兄，你可真要唯命是从了。”嵇鹤龄赶紧摇手阻止，“不是这话，不是这话！大家都是为雪岩。我先问你的意思，弟妇有句话给我，只要在情理上，一定可以如你的愿。”说到这后，胡雪岩觉得不必再玩弄什么手腕，便很率直他说道：“我不是什么荒唐的人，而且也还没有到可以荒唐的时候。没有儿子是一层，各地来去，要有个歇脚的地方，又是一层。所以我不觉得在湖州立个门户，就是对不起内人。我是尊重她，所以不让她知道，她偏偏要戳穿西洋镜，这出戏就很难唱得下去了。”“唱总要唱下去，顶了石臼也要唱。”嵇鹤龄说：“家庭之间和为贵，要和就得忍。弟妇算是忍耐了，你呢？”
en: Hu looked from one to the other and smiled. “Two fists cannot fight four hands. It seems I shall lose the argument today.” “Qiu is one of us, so I shall speak plainly. I have been asked to mediate. That alone shows your wife’s good sense. This morning I also paid my respects to your mother and received her personal instructions to settle this romantic lawsuit as your elder brother.” “Your mother’s command, your good wife’s request and your elder brother’s authority!” Qiu clapped his hands and laughed. “Brother Xueyan, you must surely obey.” Ji hastily waved him down. “That is not what I mean. Everyone is acting for Xueyan’s sake. First I want to know his wishes. His wife has told me that, provided they accord with reason and propriety, she will certainly meet them.” At this point Hu felt there was no need for further manoeuvres and spoke frankly. “I am not a dissolute man, nor have I reached a point where I can afford to be one. Having no son is one consideration; needing somewhere to rest as I travel is another. I therefore do not think that establishing a household in Huzhou wrongs my wife. I kept it from her out of respect. But she insisted on exposing the illusion, and now the play has become difficult to continue.” “It must continue even if you have to act with a stone mortar balanced on your head,” Ji replied. “Harmony matters most in a family. To achieve harmony, there must be forbearance. Your wife has shown it. What about you?”

zh: “我不是也在忍吗？凡事将就，不跟她吵，也算对得起她了。”“是的。我也知道。不过芙蓉呢？总得有个着落才好。”“目前的情形，就是着落。”“这就谈不下去了。”照此看来，胡太太提得有条件，胡雪岩心想，莫非他妻子还是坚持要遣走芙蓉？果然如此，可真的是谈不下去了。就在这显现僵局之际，裘丰言说了句很公平的话：“彼此都要让步。雪岩兄如果坚持目前的情形，似乎不对！”“对了！我也是这话。”“不坚持目前的情形又如何？莫非真的叫大家笑话我胡某人怕老婆？”“当然不是这样子。”嵇鹤龄说，“我已经听出意思来了，弟妇的想法是，你讨小纳妾都可以，不过一定要住在一起。”“这就不错了！”裘丰言说，“胡大嫂这个意思在情理上。”“情理固然说得过去，无奈还有法——妒律！”
en: “Haven’t I shown it too? I give way in everything and don’t quarrel with her. Surely I have treated her fairly.” “Yes, I know. But what about Furong? There must be some settled arrangement.” “The present situation is the arrangement.” “Then we cannot get any further.” Evidently Mrs Hu had imposed a condition. Was she still insisting that Furong be sent away? If so, there really was nothing to discuss. As they reached this deadlock, Qiu made a fair remark. “Both sides must yield something. It hardly seems right for Brother Xueyan to insist that everything remain as it is.” “Exactly! That is what I mean.” “And if it doesn’t remain as it is? Am I really to let everyone laugh at Hu Xueyan for being afraid of his wife?” “Certainly not,” Ji said. “I have understood your wife’s meaning. You may take a concubine, but she insists that you all live together.” “That is reasonable,” Qiu agreed. “Sister-in-Law Hu is within the bounds of propriety.” “It may satisfy reason and propriety,” Hu replied, “but there is still the law—the Code of Jealousy!”

zh: 这是没有理由的理由，照理一时倒还不容易解释说服，除非嵇鹤龄能提出保证！天下事什么都可保证，只有共一座江山、共一个丈夫不能保证相安无事。嵇鹤龄为难而生烦恼，因而有点迁怒到裘丰言身上。“都是你！信口开河，讲什么妒律，以至于授人以柄！”裘丰言脾气好，受此责备不以为忤，反自引咎，自斟自饮干了一杯酒说：“罚我，罚我！”“我敬一杯！”胡雪岩笑道：“都亏你提醒了我。”“不敢，不敢！”裘丰言这时才觉察到“授人以柄”这句话，不是笑谈，所以不愿再提，连连摇手说道：“雪岩兄，再莫谈妒律！不然我就变成罪魁祸首了。”胡雪岩笑一笑不答，神态闲豫。嵇鹤龄觉得事有蹊跷，异姓手足，责无旁贷，胡家的家务，也就象自己的烦恼，因而一连干了两杯酒。
en: This was an excuse without substance, yet not easy to answer with reasoning alone, unless Ji could offer a guarantee. Almost anything in the world could be guaranteed except peace between two rulers sharing a realm or two women sharing a husband. The difficulty vexed Ji, and he turned some of his annoyance on Qiu. “It is all your doing! Talking wildly about this Code of Jealousy and putting a weapon into his hands.” Good-tempered as ever, Qiu took no offence and accepted the blame. Pouring himself a cup, he drained it. “A penalty for me!” “Let me drink to you,” Hu said with a smile. “You did well to remind me.” “No, no!” Only now did Qiu realise that Ji’s complaint about giving Hu a weapon was no joke. He wanted no more of the subject. Waving his hands, he said, “Brother Xueyan, no more of the Code of Jealousy, or I shall become the chief culprit.” Hu merely smiled, looking entirely at ease. Ji felt something was amiss. As Hu’s sworn brother he could not evade responsibility; the family’s troubles were as much his concern as his own. He drank two cups in succession.

zh: “大哥！”胡雪岩极其机警，看出他有不悦之色，“你不必烦心，没有什么大不了的事。”“唉！你不晓得我的处境。”嵇鹤龄说，“如果你们夫妻反目，你想我以后怎么还有脸见老伯母？”“决不会！”胡雪岩的语气很坚定，“决不会有什么反目之事。事缓则圆，不必急在一时，等我从上海回来再说，如何？”“叫我有什么话说？”嵇鹤龄报以苦笑，“但望你心口如一，不要对弟妇生什么意见，听她的劝。”“能听一定听，不能听我也不会让她咽不下气去。”话说到这里，至矣尽矣，彼此都不再谈，饭罢看灯，深夜归去。胡雪岩只当没事人似地，依然有说有笑地，跟他妻子大谈这一天的游踪。到了第二天，瑞云来看胡太太，她是受了嵇鹤龄的委托来传话的，说胡雪岩的态度很好，事情一定有圆满结局，请胡太太放心好了。这是宽慰的话，胡太太不明就里，只是看丈夫毫无芥蒂的神情，自然相信中间人的传言。
en: “Elder Brother!” Hu was quick to notice his displeasure. “Don’t trouble yourself. It is nothing so very serious.” “You don’t understand my position,” Ji sighed. “If you and your wife fall out, how could I ever face your mother again?” “We shall not,” Hu said firmly. “There will certainly be no rupture between us. Give a matter time and it can be settled. There is no need to hurry. Shall we leave it until I return from Shanghai?” Ji answered with a rueful smile. “What can I say? I only hope you mean what you say, bear your wife no resentment and listen to her advice.” “Where I can, I certainly shall. Where I cannot, I shan’t make her swallow an unbearable grievance.” There was nothing more to say, and they dropped the subject. After dinner they went to see the lanterns and returned late. Hu behaved as though nothing had happened, laughing and talking with his wife about the day’s excursions. The next day Ruiyun visited Mrs Hu with a message from Ji: Hu’s attitude had been excellent, the matter was sure to end satisfactorily, and she need not worry. These were words of reassurance. Unaware of the true state of affairs, and seeing no trace of resentment in her husband, Mrs Hu naturally believed the mediator’s message.
